description_expanded:
This lovely vacation rental is located in The Whitby building. Guests will love the open floorplan with plenty of natural light. Located on the 2nd Floor, this condo offers views overlooking the Amphitheatre and North toward Caliza. Guests will find a spacious, open family room, kitchen and dining area and a large balcony overlooking the emerging Town Center. The primary suite features a king-sized bed with private bath. The second bedroom with a queen-sized bed also contains a private bath. Finally, the third bedroom with two twin-sized beds uses a bathroom just next to the bedroom which can also act as a private bath using a sliding door in the hallway. Parking for this vacation rental is one designated space in a parking court behind the building. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Alys Beach is expanding its development surrounding Whitby 204. The photography above may not reflect the current views as impacted by construction. For a construction map, please click the link below.
